source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When this unit is picked to shoot with **[close-quarters shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting)** in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase):

- Its attacks against a unit **engaged** with it may disregard any modifiers to **BS** and to **Hit rolls**.
- You can choose for each of its **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapons to lose **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)**.
- A weapon that loses **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** this way can target only an enemy unit that no other friendly unit is engaged with.
